plain: Status dots are gone: Badge has no dot, size or label, StatusListItem has no tone, and a plain Timeline dot is neutral, so write each status as text in a Badge.

steps.plain: Replace each <Badge dot> with a text Badge that says the status, such as <Badge tone="success">Online</Badge>, and delete its size and label props.
Delete the tone prop from every StatusListItem and the StatusListItemTone import, and put the status in a text Badge in trailing.
A TimelineItem with a tone and no icon now draws a neutral dot; pass an icon to keep a tone-coloured marker, or say the status in the title.
